title: Protein Extraction of Symbiodiniaceae from Anthopleura elegantissima
author: Virginia Weis
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.w2bfgan
materials: https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/catalog/product/sigma/p9599?lang=en®ion=US P9599 from Sigma-Aldrich (extraction from plant tissue)
1. 2% Triton X100 in FSW 2. FSW 3. Acid washed glass beads (400-600µm in diameter): https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/catalog/product/sigma/g8772?lang=en®ion=US G8772 from Sigma-Aldrich

Recipe (adjust volumes as needed): 50 mL - 100 mM Tris 50 mL - 10 mM EDTA 50 mL - 100 mM NaCl Adjust pH of the buffer to 7.4. The day of use, add 1 aliquot of Protease Inhibitor Cocktail (PIC) to 10 mL of buffer. A few options for PIC: 1. https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/catalog/product/sigma/p9599?lang=en®ion=US P9599 from Sigma-Aldrich (extraction from plant tissue) 2. https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/catalog/product/sigma/s8820?lang=en®ion=US S8820 from Sigma-Aldrich (general use)

steps.title: Prepare Animal Samples
steps.instruction: Obtain 25 frozen small Anthopleura elegantissima (alternatively, 10 medium or 3 large animals), partially defrost them, and use a razor blade to cut off the pedal discs, retaining the algal-rich tentacle crown.

steps.title: Grind and Collect Algae
steps.instruction: Grind the animals in a mini-food processor or glass-teflon grinder using 30 ml FSW.

substeps.instruction: Divide the mixture into 4-50 ml tubes.
Rinse the processor and include the rinsate in the tubes.

steps.title: Wash and Concentrate Algae
steps.instruction: Perform a series of centrifugation and rinse cycles to isolate the algae.

substeps.instruction: Spin for 6 min at 2500 xg at 4˚C.
Rinse and re-spin approximately 5 times, vigorously resuspending the pellet via vortex each time.

steps.title: Filter Algal Suspension
steps.instruction: Filter each tube of algae through 2 layers of cheesecloth to remove large chunks of tissue.

steps.title: Prepare Algal Pellet Aliquot
steps.instruction: From the resulting algal pellet (approximately 6 ml for A. elegantissima), work with 1.5 ml and freeze the remainder.

steps.title: Wash Algae with Triton X100
steps.instruction: Wash the 1.5 ml algal pellet to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 ml of FSW with 2% triton X100 and resuspend algae via vortex.
Spin at 2,500 xg for 6 min at 4˚C, then remove and discard the greenish-yellow supernatant.
Rinse the pellet once more with 10 ml of FSW with 2% triton X100 and spin again at 2,500 xg for 6 min at 4˚C.

steps.title: Extract Protein via Bead Beating
steps.instruction: Lyse the algae using extraction buffer and glass beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 3.75 ml of extraction buffer (with PIC) to the pellet, resuspend the algae, and place the suspension in a glass culture tube.
Add 1-2 ml of acid-washed glass beads.
Vortex the suspension for 30 sec, then place on ice for 30 sec; repeat this cycle a total of 20 times.

steps.title: Clarify Protein Extract
steps.instruction: Separate the protein extract from the cellular debris and beads.

substeps.instruction: Remove the suspension away from the glass beads and place it into microfuge tubes.
Spin at 15,000 rpm in a microfuge for 5 min at 4˚C to obtain a deep, clear orange supernatant.

steps.title: Quantify Protein Concentration
steps.instruction: Determine the protein concentration of the supernatant using a Bradford or other protein quantification assay.
